name: office
description: Synthetic but wire-valid Node Status packet (opcode 0x39, Request=0xFF/'own node') — a real, documented Casambi opcode the driver's event normalizer does NOT map to any discovery/feedback signal (it's only used as a probe() response check). Decodes successfully but is deliberately ignored downstream — exercises the exact 'Adapter decoded, Discovery ignored packet — opcode not mapped' failure mode the Failure Analysis report names.

metadata.notes: SYNTHETIC, hand-constructed per the documented opcode 0x39 byte layout — not from real hardware. Deliberately exercises the 'unmapped opcode' failure path, not a real-world scenario to fix.
